STRUCTURED WORKER ESCALATION CONTRACT. If you cannot safely complete the task because you lack authority or need a manager/user decision, do not only refuse in prose. Stop and write a concise explanation first, then END your final message with exactly one fenced `wks-escalation` JSON block in this exact shape:

```wks-escalation
{
  "type": "worker-escalation",
  "status": "blocked",
  "reason": "concise blocker",
  "requiredAuthorityOrDecision": "specific authority or decision needed",
  "changed": false,
  "nextAction": "useful next action for the manager"
}
```

Use this only as a terminal escalation, not for a successful completion or a routine progress update. Report truthfully whether anything changed. If a separate `wks-result` contract is also present, emit `wks-result` when you complete the task; when you escalate, emit `wks-escalation` instead. Emit the chosen terminal block only once and put nothing after it.
